name: com.get0cean/0cean
title: 0cean
description: Ask independent online stores at once: live prices, stock and delivery. Read-only shopping search.

tools.name: ask_stores
tools.description: Asks the independent online stores that sell this kind of product and returns each store's own offer: product, price, stock, a picture and a link to the product on the store's site. Write the request in a few English words ("dark roast whole bean coffee", "folding e-bike under $1,500"); a sentence or another language goes to shop_for_wish. Pass conditions as fields; to narrow results, keep the request and add fields. Nothing is bought.

request.description: What the buyer needs, in a few English words. May end with "under $50".

limit.description: How many offers, best first. Default 10.

max_price.description: Optional. The most the buyer will pay, in the buyer's currency.

min_price.description: Optional. The least, in the same currency.

price_currency.description: Optional. The currency max_price and min_price were said in, when it is not the buyer's ("under $80" from a buyer in Germany: max_price 80, price_currency "USD", country "DE").

country.description: Optional. The buyer's country, two letters (ISO 3166-1): "DE", "GB".

currency.description: Optional. The buyer's currency, three letters: "EUR".

must.description: Optional. Words the product must have: a colour, a size, a material.

not.description: Optional. Words the product's name must not have.

cheapest.description: Optional. true: the lowest price first.

sort_by.description: Optional. Fastest delivery, lowest total with delivery, best rated, most reliable store, or real deals first.

ships_here.description: Optional. true: only stores whose shipping policy names the buyer's country.

max_days.description: Optional. Delivered within this many days.

min_rating.description: Optional. At least this many stars, of five.

tools.name: shop_for_wish
tools.description: Takes what the person wants, in any language: the product or who it is for, a budget, the country. Returns stores' offers, or one question when it names no product. To go on, call again with the person's answer and the `record` the last answer gave. Nothing is bought.

wish.description: What the person wants: the product or who it is for, a budget, the country. Leave out names, addresses, cities and other personal details.

record.description: Optional. The `record` the last answer gave, to go on from it.

country.description: Optional. The buyer's country, two letters (ISO 3166-1): "DE", "GB".

currency.description: Optional. The buyer's currency, three letters: "EUR".

limit.description: How many offers, best first. Default 10.

tools.name: store_delivery
tools.description: What stores' own shipping policies say: the countries they ship to, the days, the cost or a free-shipping threshold. Pass the `domain` of offers (at most 12) and the buyer's country. A fact a policy does not state is left empty; the store shows the exact cost of an order.

country.description: Optional. The buyer's country, two letters (ISO 3166-1): "DE", "GB".

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The kinds of product the stores answer in, with how many stores answer in each. A slug narrows ask_stores.

tools.name: about_network
tools.description: How this connector works: where the offers come from, how they are ordered, and which goods it leaves out.
